captions.detailed: This 3D model is a customizable wall mounting bracket designed to hold a flat object against a wall. It features a flat backing plate with a single countersunk screw hole in the center for mounting. Perpendicular to this plate is a C-shaped channel or clamp section with beveled inner and outer corners for structural strength and smooth edges.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable wall bracket in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust parameters such as the clamp size (thickness of the clamped object), material thickness, rim height of the front bracket, and corner bevel size, complete with a countersunk mounting hole on the back plate.
captions.factory: The bracket is constructed by first defining a 2D polygon that represents the cross-section of both the flat wall plate and the C-shaped clamp, incorporating bevels defined by the 'Corner' parameter. This profile is extruded using linear_extrude to the desired width. Finally, a difference operation subtracts a rotated, double-radius cylinder to form a countersunk mounting hole in the back plate.
